channel.title: Paintbrush Changelog
channel.description: Changes made to the Paintbrush revival application by Jarrod Norwell

item.title: Version 4.1
item.description: # Added - fill style support to the toolbox allowing for no-fill, borderless and filled shapes # Changed - the design of the save panel to be more consistent with the rest of the app # Fixed - an issue where saving as JPEG or TIFF would "fail" due to being unable to read the saved file

item.title: Version 4.0
item.description: # Added - new Sparke changelog and update implementation # Fixed - saving for all previously supported file formats - (partially) pasting an image from the pasteboard - an issue where saving would throw a warning that it could not read the saved file
